Enables + starts the packaged charly-mcp unit on this deployment (systemctl enable --now via the use_packaged service declaration). The units ship non-autostarting; this candy is the bed's explicit, charly-native start for the MCP checks.

## Packages

Installed on every distro:

- `charly`

## Services

- `charly-mcp`

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | write the all-interfaces drop-in (a root command step — the run:file step's provision ran as the guest user, mkdir Permission-denied, R1ed) |
| `run` | reload systemd and restart charly-mcp so the drop-in takes effect |
| `check` | the packaged charly-mcp unit is installed (the service declaration enables it) |
| `check` | the all-interfaces drop-in override is present |
